Module com.tasktopia
Package com.tasktopia.util

Class Styles

java.lang.Object
com.tasktopia.util.Styles
public final class Styles extends Object
Centralised repository of inline JavaFX CSS style strings for the Tasktopia UI.

All methods return a ready-to-use value for Node.setStyle(String). Colour constants are exposed as public static final fields so that other classes can reference the palette directly.

This class is a utility class and cannot be instantiated.

      public static void applyHoverEffect(javafx.scene.control.Button btn, String baseStyle, String hoverStyle)

      public static String taskName(boolean done)
      Returns the inline style for a task name label.

      When done is true the text is rendered in the muted colour with a strikethrough to indicate completion.

      Parameters:
      done - true if the task has been marked as complete
      Returns:
      a JavaFX CSS style string

    • badge

      public static String badge(String type)
      Returns the inline style for a small pill-shaped badge.

      Supported type values:

      • "high" — red badge for high-priority tasks
      • "medium" — amber badge for medium-priority tasks
      • "low" — green badge for low-priority tasks
      • "category" — blue badge for category labels
      • anything else — neutral grey badge
      Parameters:
      type - a string key identifying the badge variant
      Returns:
      a JavaFX CSS style string

    • checkCircle

      public static String checkCircle(boolean done)
      Returns the inline style for a circular task-completion toggle button.

      A filled circle (primary colour with a checkmark) is shown when the task is done; an empty bordered circle is shown otherwise.

      Parameters:
      done - true if the task has been marked as complete
      Returns:
      a JavaFX CSS style string
